_meta.description: Question bank for the adaptive inquiry (SOP §4.2, §4.8): plain-language prompts, options mapped to symptom ids, prerequisites, modules. Answering a question records selected symptoms as present and the others of that question as absent; skipping records unsure.

hint.en: Feeling cold despite warm clothing often goes with a recent chill; cold that eases with warmth often goes with a constitutionally cold, weak pattern.
hint.zh-Hant: 「即使穿暖還是冷」多見於剛受涼；「怕冷但保暖會好」多見於體質偏虛寒。

label.en: I still feel cold even when dressed warmly or under blankets
label.zh-Hant: 即使穿得暖、蓋了被子，還是覺得冷

label.en: I feel the cold, but warmth or hot food makes it better
label.zh-Hant: 怕冷，但保暖或吃熱的東西就會好一點

label.en: My hands and feet are often icy cold

prompt.en: Do you feel the cold more than usual lately? Select all that apply.
prompt.zh-Hant: 最近您是否特別怕冷？符合的請全選。

label.en: I have a fever (a high temperature or feeling feverish)
label.zh-Hant: 有發熱（量體溫偏高，或自覺在發燒）

label.en: I feel hot and clammy inside, though my skin does not feel very hot
label.zh-Hant: 摸起來不太燙，但裡面悶熱、黏膩不爽快

label.en: I tend to feel feverish in the afternoon or evening
label.zh-Hant: 下午或傍晚特別容易發熱

label.en: My palms, soles and chest often feel hot
label.zh-Hant: 手心、腳心和胸口常常發熱

label.en: I dislike heat and prefer cool surroundings
I alternate between chills and fever
label.zh-Hant: 一陣冷、一陣熱，輪流出現

prompt.en: Have you had any fever or feelings of heat lately? Select all that apply.
prompt.zh-Hant: 最近有沒有發熱或覺得悶熱的感覺？符合的請全選。

label.en: I sweat easily with little effort, or even sitting still in the daytime
label.zh-Hant: 稍微活動，或白天坐著不動也容易出汗

label.en: I sweat while asleep and it stops when I wake
label.zh-Hant: 睡著後出汗，醒來就停了

label.en: I do not sweat when I would expect to (after exercise, in heat, or with fever and chills)
label.zh-Hant: 該出汗的時候（運動後、悶熱時或發燒怕冷時）卻沒有汗

prompt.en: How is your sweating? Select all that apply.
prompt.zh-Hant: 您平常出汗的情況如何？符合的請全選。

label.en: My head feels heavy, as if wrapped
Dizziness, blackouts of vision or a spinning feeling
label.zh-Hant: 頭暈、眼前發黑或天旋地轉

label.en: A distending headache, as if my head would burst

prompt.en: Do you have any of these head symptoms? Select all that apply.
prompt.zh-Hant: 頭部有沒有以下不舒服？符合的請全選。

label.en: Numbness in the hands or feet
An aching, weak lower back and knees
An aching, cold lower back and knees

prompt.en: And your body and limbs? Select all that apply.
prompt.zh-Hant: 身體和四肢呢？符合的請全選。

label.en: Stabbing pain in a fixed spot
Pain that is worse at night

prompt.en: How would you describe the pain? Select all that apply.
prompt.zh-Hant: 關於疼痛的性質，符合的有哪些？

label.en: Dry, hard stools that are difficult to pass
Sticky stools and a feeling of incomplete emptying

label.zh-Hant: 吃進去的東西幾乎沒消化就排出來

prompt.en: How have your bowel movements been? Select all that apply.
prompt.zh-Hant: 最近大便的情況如何？符合的請全選。

label.en: I get up several times at night to urinate
label.zh-Hant: 夜裡要起來上好幾次廁所

label.en: Small amounts of dark yellow urine
Large amounts of pale, clear urine

prompt.en: And your urination? Select all that apply.
prompt.zh-Hant: 小便的情況呢？符合的請全選。

label.en: Poor appetite; I do not feel like eating
My abdomen feels bloated after eating
I feel hungry but do not want to eat or cannot eat
label.zh-Hant: 會餓，但又不想吃或吃不下

prompt.en: How are your appetite and how you feel after eating? Select all that apply.
prompt.zh-Hant: 食慾和飯後的感覺如何？符合的請全選。

label.en: A bitter taste in the mouth
A sticky, greasy feeling in the mouth
A bland mouth; food tastes of little
Sour fluid or acid coming up

prompt.en: What about tastes in your mouth, or your stomach? Select all that apply.
prompt.zh-Hant: 嘴巴裡的味道或胃的感覺呢？符合的請全選。

label.en: I prefer hot food; cold food upsets me
label.zh-Hant: 喜歡熱食，吃冷的會不舒服

label.en: I prefer cold or cool food

prompt.en: Do you prefer hot or cold food?
prompt.zh-Hant: 您比較喜歡吃熱的還是冷的食物？

hint.en: Persistent vomiting or being unable to keep food or drink down needs prompt medical care.
hint.zh-Hant: 持續嘔吐、無法進食或喝水，請盡快就醫。

prompt.en: Do you have any of these around meals or in general?
prompt.zh-Hant: 吃東西前後或平常，有沒有以下情況？

hint.en: Palpitations with chest pain, cold sweat or difficulty breathing need urgent medical care.
hint.zh-Hant: 心悸若伴隨胸痛、冒冷汗或呼吸困難，請立即就醫。

label.zh-Hant: 心悸（感覺心跳很快或心在亂跳）

label.en: Chest tightness, as if something is pressing
Distending pain at the sides of the ribs
A feeling of something stuck in the throat that I can neither swallow nor cough up
label.zh-Hant: 喉嚨像有東西卡住，吞不下也吐不出

prompt.en: Any discomfort in the chest or along the ribs? Select all that apply.
prompt.zh-Hant: 胸口和兩側肋骨附近有沒有不舒服？符合的請全選。

hint.en: Severe abdominal pain needs medical care; do not self-manage.
hint.zh-Hant: 劇烈腹痛請就醫，不要自行處理。

label.en: Distending pain in the upper abdomen
A dull, burning ache in the stomach
Fullness and stuffiness in the upper or whole abdomen
label.zh-Hant: 上腹或整個肚子悶脹、痞滿

label.en: Abdominal pain that likes warmth or pressure
label.zh-Hant: 肚子痛，喜歡熱敷或按壓

label.en: Abdominal fullness that comes and goes
A bearing-down feeling in the abdomen
label.zh-Hant: 肚子或下腹有往下墜的感覺

prompt.en: How do your stomach and abdomen feel? Select all that apply.
prompt.zh-Hant: 胃部和肚子的感覺呢？符合的請全選。

label.en: Pressing makes it worse; I do not want it touched

label.zh-Hant: 差不多，沒有特別的感覺

prompt.en: How does it feel when you press on your abdomen?
prompt.zh-Hant: 用手按壓肚子時，感覺如何？

hint.en: A sudden change in vision needs prompt medical care.
hint.zh-Hant: 視力突然改變請盡快就醫。

label.en: Loud ringing in the ears, like surf
Thin, high ringing in the ears, like cicadas

prompt.en: Any problems with your ears or eyes? Select all that apply.
prompt.zh-Hant: 耳朵和眼睛有沒有不舒服？符合的請全選。

label.en: Sores in the mouth or on the tongue

prompt.en: And your throat and mouth? Select all that apply.
prompt.zh-Hant: 喉嚨和口腔呢？符合的請全選。

label.en: I am thirsty and want cold drinks
I feel thirsty but do not want to drink

prompt.en: How is your thirst? Select all that apply.
prompt.zh-Hant: 口渴的情形如何？符合的請全選。

label.en: I find it hard to fall asleep
I wake up easily or often
Vexation that keeps me from sleeping

prompt.en: How has your sleep been? Select all that apply.
prompt.zh-Hant: 最近睡眠怎麼樣？符合的請全選。

prompt.en: Do you notice any of these?
prompt.zh-Hant: 心神方面，有沒有以下情況？

hint.en: If you have thoughts of harming yourself or others, seek help immediately.
hint.zh-Hant: 若出現傷害自己或他人的念頭，請立即尋求協助。

label.en: My physical symptoms start or worsen with emotion
label.zh-Hant: 身體的不舒服常因為情緒而發作或加重

label.en: I think too much and worry excessively

prompt.en: How has your mood been? Select all that apply.
prompt.zh-Hant: 最近的情緒狀態如何？符合的請全選。

label.en: Short of breath on slight effort
I do not feel like talking; speaking is an effort

prompt.en: Which of these describe your energy and stamina? Select all that apply.
prompt.zh-Hant: 精神和體力方面，符合的有哪些？

prompt.en: How are your periods and vaginal discharge? Select all that apply.
prompt.zh-Hant: 月經和白帶的情況如何？符合的請全選。

label.zh-Hant: 遺精（非性行為時精液自行排出）

prompt.en: Do you have any of the following?
prompt.zh-Hant: 有沒有以下男性方面的情況？

label.en: A dry cough with little phlegm
A blocked nose with clear discharge
A blocked nose without much discharge

prompt.en: What about cough, phlegm, nose and voice? Select all that apply.
prompt.zh-Hant: 咳嗽、痰、鼻子和說話的聲音呢？符合的請全選。

hint.en: Recent and long-standing problems point in different directions in TCM pattern differentiation.
hint.zh-Hant: 新起的不適與長期的不適，在中醫裡的辨證方向不同。

label.en: They started recently, within the past two weeks
Between two weeks and three months

prompt.en: About how long have these problems lasted?
prompt.zh-Hant: 這些不舒服大約持續多久了？

hint.en: A sudden start after a chill points to a new external illness; long-standing, repeated sweating is different.
hint.zh-Hant: 剛受風寒而起，與長期反覆自汗不同。

label.en: Yes, it began soon after being caught in wind or cold
label.zh-Hant: 是，受風受涼後不久就開始

prompt.en: Did this start soon after you were caught in wind, cold or rain?
prompt.zh-Hant: 這種不舒服，是不是在受風、受涼或淋雨之後不久才開始的？

label.en: Noisy nasal breathing, or feeling like retching with nothing coming up
label.zh-Hant: 鼻子呼吸有聲、鼻塞，或想吐卻吐不出

label.en: A stiff, tight neck or upper back

prompt.en: Do you also have any of these? Select all that apply.
prompt.zh-Hant: 同時有沒有以下情況？符合的請全選。

hint.en: Repeated, regular spells of fever and sweating with no other illness are traditionally read as a disharmony of the nutrient and defensive qi.
hint.zh-Hant: 反覆、定時的發熱自汗而無其他疾病，傳統上屬營衛不和。

label.en: Yes, repeated spells of feeling feverish and sweating
label.zh-Hant: 有，一陣陣發熱出汗，反覆好幾次

prompt.en: Do you have spells of feeling feverish and sweating again and again even though you are not otherwise ill?
prompt.zh-Hant: 有沒有這種情形：平時並沒有生什麼病，卻一陣一陣地發熱、出汗，反覆發作？

label.en: I get short of breath with even slight exertion
My voice fades and I tire after talking for a while
label.zh-Hant: 話說久了，聲音變小、沒力氣

prompt.en: Do you get short of breath or tired when walking, climbing stairs or talking for a while?
prompt.zh-Hant: 走路、爬樓梯或說話久了，會不會氣喘、氣短或更沒力氣？

label.en: Yes, I catch a cold at every change and recover slowly
label.zh-Hant: 是，一換季就感冒，好得慢

prompt.en: Do you catch a cold whenever the weather or the season changes, and take long to get over it?
prompt.zh-Hant: 是不是一換季或天氣變化就容易感冒，而且好得很慢？

label.en: Loose teeth, or gums and tooth roots that often ache
label.zh-Hant: 牙齒鬆動，或牙根常常痠軟

prompt.en: Have you noticed any of these lately? Select all that apply.
prompt.zh-Hant: 最近有沒有以下情況？符合的請全選。

prompt.en: Is your hearing not as good as it used to be?
prompt.zh-Hant: 聽力有沒有比以前差？

label.en: My mind will not stop; thoughts race
label.zh-Hant: 腦子停不下來，思緒紛亂

label.en: A burning, stinging tip of the tongue

prompt.en: At night, do you notice any of these? Select all that apply.
prompt.zh-Hant: 夜裡心裡有沒有以下的感覺？符合的請全選。

hint.en: Look in natural light. Self-judgement is limited in accuracy, so this counts for less in the calculation.
hint.zh-Hant: 請在自然光下觀察；自行判斷的準確度有限，因此在計算中的權重較低。

label.en: Flushed: the whole face or both cheeks are red

label.zh-Hant: 晦暗：發暗、發黑、沒有光彩

prompt.en: Look in a mirror: which best describes your complexion?
prompt.zh-Hant: 請對著鏡子看看，您的氣色比較接近哪一種？

prompt.en: What about your lips, nails and skin? Select all that apply.
prompt.zh-Hant: 嘴唇、指甲和皮膚的樣子呢？符合的請全選。

description.en: Trouble falling asleep, waking often, vivid dreams

description.zh-Hant: 沒力氣、容易累、精神不振

description.en: Bloating, appetite, stomach discomfort, bowel habits
Feeling cold or hot, cold hands and feet, sweating
description.zh-Hant: 怕冷、怕熱、手腳冰冷、盜汗自汗

description.en: Menstrual cycle, flow, period pain, discharge
description.zh-Hant: 月經週期、經量、痛經、白帶

description.en: A recent cold- or flu-like illness (mild only)
description.zh-Hant: 剛開始的感冒樣不適（輕症）
